candidates.objective: Forms: labels, input types, select, checkbox/radio, submit/reset and keyboard behavior.
Small isolated HTML/JavaScript cases: tables, dialogs, navigation, frames, controls and dynamic content.
Interaction cases: delayed loading, uploads/downloads, frames, windows and dialogs.
Todo workflow: create/edit/complete/filter/delete, focus, event ordering and reload persistence.
Actionability and timing: changing identifiers, delayed controls, scrolling and covered elements.
Complex widgets: date pickers, autocomplete, tabs, dialogs and drag/drop.
Multi-page catalog/search/cart workflow; stop before purchases or real-account changes.
Large real documentation pages: tables, anchors, search, code blocks, responsive navigation.
Dense source/code pages, long identifiers, links, overflow and scroll restoration.
Modern documentation navigation, hydration/runtime behavior and history.
Additional framework/runtime patterns and navigation behavior.
Unicode, long definitions, nested lists/tables and internal links.
RTL and Arabic content/selection; distinguish reader access from actual shaping/rendering.
Long documents, encodings, download MIME handling and navigation.
Passkey create/get, cancellation, challenge/origin/RP checks with dedicated test credentials.
Expected-positive and expected-negative TLS/certificate cases; never disable verification to pass.
Use selected upstream tests in an owned local fixture server; this is a suite source, not app acceptance.

controlledChallengeCandidate: An owned Cloudflare zone using official Turnstile test keys; verify success/failure/expiry and handoff, not unauthorized third-party challenge bypass.
